checks.description: Manifest identity, model version, and file receipts are valid.
Package contains exactly the 32 registered canonical CSV paths.
CSV headers exactly match the ordered typed registry.
Byte length, digest, and row count match manifest receipts.
Values satisfy registry SQL types and nullability.
Case and snapshot identity are consistent across rows.
Primary keys are present and unique.
Reference endpoints resolve to canonical records.
Exactly one approved package profile is present.
Published and Genie-safe layers contain no protected truth.
Required source and derivation provenance is present and structurally valid.
Canonical model version is supported by the repository contract.
